name: pauses-before-push-by-default
description: With no settings file, the skill builds the plan and stops for approval before any push or PR, and it commits from a message file.
prompt:
I finished the change on branch feature/proj-42 and the working tree has edits. Ship this.

You have no network or tool access in this environment — do NOT call any tools, and
assume no settings file exists. Tell me, in order, what you do before, at, and after
the point where something leaves my machine, and the exact git command you use to commit.

assertions.description: asks for approval before anything leaves the machine
never commits with an inline message
derives the ticket key from the branch name
